_meta.purpose: Registry of channel video-pipeline scripts and their status (active/superseded/legacy), so 'what is this script for' questions get answered by reading this file instead of re-deriving from scratch each time.

reimagined_realms_pov_shorts.note: Sibling pipeline to the existing long-form Reimagined Realms pipeline — vertical (9:16) historical 'day in the life' POV YouTube Shorts, no dialogue, min 60-65s. Skill: 001_Architecture/Skills/Reimagined_Realms_POV_Shorts_Pipeline/SKILL.md. Built via subagent-driven-development across 6 plans (Video-Analyzer, Foley-Generator+Seedance-Guide, Beat-Planning/Shot-List, Image/Video-Generation, Assembly, Text-Overlay). First real end-to-end production ('Pyramid Builder I. Deep', 0003) completed and published 2026-08-03 to YouTube/TikTok/Instagram/Facebook via Blotato.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: beat_planning.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: scenes_needed_for_floor() pads scene count to the 65s floor at seconds_per_scene; write_beat_table() writes Data/Beat_Table.json.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: shot_list_builder.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: build_video_prompt() assembles the Seedance prompt and auto-appends the locked negative-prompt closer; raises ValueError on any quoted dialogue detected (safety-critical — dialogue triggers Seedance lip-sync). write_shot_list() writes Production/Shot_List.md.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: image_generation.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: generate_image() via kie-cli gpt_image_2 (GPT-Image-2), 9:16. Case-insensitive status polling for kie-cli's raw upstream states.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: video_generation.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: generate_video() via WaveSpeed bytedance/seedance-v1.5-pro/image-to-video with generate_audio=true (native synced foley/ambient, chosen over dedicated Foley models after a live A/B test). Reference image must be uploaded to a public URL first via 'wavespeed upload <path> --json'. trim_to_best_window() clips to a target duration.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: assembly.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: concatenate_videos(), measure_lufs()/calculate_gain()/mix_and_normalize() (locked -14 LUFS formula, amix requires explicit normalize=0 or it silently re-attenuates both tracks), get_next_version()/mux_final() for versioned Final_vN.mp4.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: audio_extraction.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: extract_audio() pulls each clip's native Seedance audio; stitch_audio_files() concatenates into Ambient_Foley_Full.mp3.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: music_generation.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: generate_music() via kie-cli Suno; fit_music_to_duration() trims or loops-then-trims to the exact target runtime.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: text_overlay.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: build_caption_props()/write_props_file() build the Remotion POVShort props (snake_case -> camelCase). ensure_public_symlink() links the production folder into 003_Remotion/public/ so staticFile() resolves. render_text_overlay() invokes 'npx remotion render POVShort'.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: generate_foley.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: Swappable Mirelo/Sonilo Foley/SFX generator, built and tested but superseded in the main pipeline by Seedance's native generate_audio=true after a live A/B test. Kept as a fallback tool, not called by the default flow.

new_pipeline_remotion_components.name: POVCaption.tsx
new_pipeline_remotion_components.purpose: TimedCaption component: white/centered/drop-shadow text, top-18% safe zone (locked after Tony's critique of the Pyramid Builder v1 render), fade in/out except captions starting at frame 0 (opening title), which render at full opacity immediately since YouTube Shorts auto-grabs an early frame as the thumbnail.

new_pipeline_remotion_components.name: POVShort.tsx
new_pipeline_remotion_components.purpose: Composition combining OffthreadVideo background + mapped POVCaption elements from a captions[] prop. Registered in Root.tsx. Note: durationInFrames is currently a hardcoded 1560-frame (65s) placeholder, not yet wired to actual clip duration — fine when the production's real runtime is exactly 65s (as Pyramid Builder I. Deep's 13x5s shot list is), freeze-frames on the last video frame otherwise.

distribution.note: Publishing is manual (Blotato MCP tool calls), not yet a dedicated script/skill module. Locked as of 2026-08-03: every finished POV Short posts to all four — YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook.

blotato_accounts.youtube: 30323 (ReimaginedRealms channel; has topical playlists as subaccounts, e.g. 'Ancient Egypt History Reimagined')
blotato_accounts.facebook: 18651 / pageId 407939555731086 (Reimagined Realms page, a subaccount of Tony's personal Facebook account)

distribution.ai_disclosure_fields: YouTube has containsSyntheticMedia (bool); TikTok has isAiGenerated (bool). Instagram and Facebook have no equivalent field in the blotato_create_post schema as of 2026-08-03 — cannot be set programmatically.

anomalous_wild.note: First video pipeline ever built in this workspace (predates Reimagined Realms). Early tooling (below) is fragmented across eras. A unifying orchestrator skill is now BUILT (2026-07-07/08): 001_Architecture/Skills/Anomalous_Wild_Video_Pipeline/SKILL.md, invoke via /anomalous-wild. See 'new_pipeline_scripts' for its own scripts, built via subagent-driven-development with per-task review + a final whole-branch review.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: build_motion_graphics_profile.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: Builds data/motion_graphics_capabilities.json — research-backed capability profile (Remotion, video-use, Hyperframes, Manim), every entry cites a real source. Consulted by Tool-Manager for per-beat tool routing.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: generate_narration_with_timestamps.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: Thin wrapper around Tools/Text-To-Speech/audio_tts.py's generate_voiceover_with_timestamps(). Reads Scripts/Narration.md, writes per-scene audio.mp3 + word-level beat_sheet.json.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: build_beat_table.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: Reads per-scene beat_sheet.json + Scene_Routing.json, writes Production/Beat_Table.json. Locks max_clip_s=8.0 for live_footage beats, max_static_s=5.0 for diagram beats.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: diagram_research_and_illustrate.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: Scientific Diagram sub-pipeline steps 1-2: Openverse reference search + clean no-text illustration via kie.ai GPT-Image-2 (gpt-image-2-text-to-image). Fixes the garbled-diagram-text problem from the Bioluminescence Weapon video.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: detect_label_coordinates.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: Scientific Diagram sub-pipeline step 3: Gemini vision pass detects real per-image label coordinates. Structurally strips coordinates from not_found entries — never guesses a placement, code-enforced not just prompt-enforced.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: generate_youtube_package.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: Adapts RR's title/description/thumbnail formulas to AW's science/nature framing. Generates 3 titles + description + actually generates/downloads 3 real thumbnail PNGs via kie.ai.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: scaffold_new_production.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: Going-forward folder scaffolder: 8 typed folders matching RR's pattern, hard-fails if the locked end_card_v3.mp4 (Brand_Assets/End_Card/) is missing.

new_pipeline_docs.name: upload_to_blotato.md
new_pipeline_docs.purpose: Blotato upload procedure, mirrors RR Phase 12 locked defaults. Confirmed accountId 42514 (displayed as 'Anomalos Wild', a spelling variant — confirmed correct by Tony 2026-07-08).

new_pipeline_remotion_components.name: DiagramLabels.tsx
new_pipeline_remotion_components.purpose: Scientific Diagram sub-pipeline step 4: places labels/callout lines at detected coordinates. Registered via Zod schema= prop (diagramLabelsSchema), matching AIVideo/aiVideoSchema pattern, not a type-erasure cast. x_pct/y_pct optional so not_found labels don't crash the composition.

cross_cutting_bugs_fixed_2026_07_08: detect_label_coordinates.py's not_found coordinate-stripping was rejected by DiagramLabels.tsx's original required-field Zod schema (would crash diagram assembly on the exact safety-path scenario) — fixed by making x_pct/y_pct optional + a hasCoordinates() type guard.

The 3-5s no-static-frame rule (max_static_s) was recorded in Beat_Table.json but never enforced anywhere — fixed by adding a mandatory per-beat static-hold check to Anomalous_Wild_Video_Pipeline/SKILL.md's Phase 7 (Assembly).

scripts.name: pipeline_supervisor.py
scripts.purpose: Batch clip generator with real error-code classification (FATAL/CREDITS/SKIP/RATE/WAIT/RETRY/UNKNOWN), retries, macOS notifications, auto-preloop after each success.

scripts.name: run_new_clips_batch.py
scripts.purpose: Simpler batch generator, same core job as pipeline_supervisor.py, only ever used for Bioluminescence Weapon despite living in Generic_Tools. Has a diagram-safety negative-prompt feature pipeline_supervisor.py lacks (see notes).
scripts.notes: Auto-appends 'no text, no labels, no callout lines, no arrows, no annotation marks' for image entries marked is_diagram:true, added after the Video 001 Report Card caught garbled diagram text. Didn't fully work (negative prompts alone don't reliably stop text rendering). The idea carries forward into the new pipeline's Scientific Diagram sub-pipeline (reference research + vision-coordinate verification + Remotion labels), which is the actual fix. Left in place, unused going forward.

scripts.name: preloop_new_clips.py
scripts.purpose: Post-processes freshly generated clips into looped versions matching narration duration.

scripts.name: preloop_videos.sh
scripts.purpose: Same preloop job as preloop_new_clips.py, for the original 12 hero clips with hardcoded durations.
scripts.notes: Needed bash 4+ for declare -A associative arrays; system bash was 3.2. Fixed 2026-07-07 via 'brew install bash' (5.3.15 installed at /opt/homebrew/bin/bash, ahead of /bin/bash in PATH, so plain 'bash' now resolves to it with no script changes). Verified working end-to-end.

scripts.name: pipeline_orchestrator.sh
scripts.purpose: 6-stage wrapper chaining run_new_clips_batch.py -> preloop_new_clips.py -> preloop_videos.sh -> check_pipeline_status.py.
scripts.notes: Was calling a 004_Tools/ path that stopped existing after a June 2026 reorg (scripts moved to 001_Architecture/Tools/Video-Generation/). Fixed 2026-07-07 to use absolute paths to the real locations.

scripts.name: check_pipeline_status.py
scripts.purpose: Read-only progress report: which clips/images are done vs. pending.

scripts.name: generate_stems_v2a.py
scripts.purpose: DEFAULT SFX/ambience generator (locked 2026-09-04, Glass Frog 0003 graded A). Video-to-audio: segments a picture-locked render on scene boundaries (Data/v2a_segment_map.json, <=60s), runs each through fal.ai Mirelo SFX v1.6 (mirelo-ai/sfx1.6/video-to-video), crossfade-concats to Assembly/V2A/v2a_bed.mp3. generate_stems.py (ElevenLabs) is now the fallback. Segment cut must be downscaled+bitrate-capped or the fal upload stalls.

remotion_components.name: BioluminescenceDoc.tsx
remotion_components.purpose: The actual Remotion composition that assembles Bioluminescence Weapon. Hardcoded to that video's specific scenes/durations.

remotion_components.name: AnomalousWildEndCard.tsx
remotion_components.purpose: Channel-wide end card composition. In practice the pipeline appends the pre-rendered end_card_v3.mp4 via ffmpeg instead of re-rendering this per video (locked rule in DESIGN.md).

reimagined_realms_pov_shorts_v2.note: Versioned duplicate of reimagined_realms_pov_shorts (v1), created 2026-08-04 to fix identity-drift via Seedance 2.0's multi-reference conditioning. Locked and production-proven as of 2026-08-09 (no longer a POC) — sheet-driven architecture (character/prop/environment sheets), first_frame_url-only video generation, 126/126 tests passing. Skill: 001_Architecture/Skills/Reimagined_Realms_POV_Shorts_Pipeline_v2/SKILL.md. Two full productions published end-to-end: Roman Gladiator (0005), Titanic Stoker (0004, shots 2/9/13 regenerated).

new_pipeline_scripts.name: character_sheet_generation.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: generate_character_sheet(character_description, output_path, role="the main character", ...) — one 3x3-grid reference sheet per distinct character via GPT-Image-2. Role is always freeform text, never a hardcoded title set.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: prop_sheet_generation.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: generate_prop_sheet(props, output_path, ...) — front/back/held_left/held_right panels per prop, hand-specific (never a generic single held panel — caused a real thumb-orientation bug).

new_pipeline_scripts.name: environment_sheet_generation.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: generate_environment_sheet(location_name, scene_angles, output_path, ...) — one sheet per location, one panel per scene, strictly people-less, never merged/reused.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: storyboard_generation.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: generate_storyboard(beats, output_dir, ...) — one individually-generated POV-locked 9:16 panel per beat, written to output_dir/Scenes/ (enforced subfolder convention); compose_contact_sheet() composites captions via PIL, never AI-generated.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: shot_list_builder.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: build_video_prompt(scene_description, sound_events, camera_fixed, character_roles=None) — auto-prepends POV_LOCK_CLAUSE, auto-appends negative-prompt closer, blocks quoted dialogue. character_roles/@Image tagging only valid in the reference_image_urls fallback path, never alongside first_frame_url.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: video_generation.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: generate_video(video_prompt, output_path, first_frame_url=None, reference_image_urls=None, ...) — Seedance 2.0 via kie.ai. first_frame_url and reference_image_urls are mutually exclusive on the live endpoint (confirmed 2026-08-08) — raises ValueError if both passed. Normal path: first_frame_url alone.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: image_generation.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: generate_image(prompt, output_path, aspect_ratio, resolution, input_urls=None) — GPT-Image-2 via kie.ai, up to 16 reference images.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: beat_planning.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: Same as v1 — scenes_needed_for_floor()/write_beat_table(), unchanged.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: assembly.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: Same as v1 — concatenate_videos/mix_and_normalize/mux_final, unchanged.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: audio_extraction.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: Same as v1 — extract_audio/stitch_audio_files, unchanged.

new_pipeline_scripts.name: music_generation.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: generate_music/fit_music_to_duration via Suno — non-custom mode caps --prompt at 500 chars (confirmed 2026-08-09, a long descriptive prompt fails outright).

new_pipeline_scripts.name: text_overlay.py
new_pipeline_scripts.purpose: build_caption_props/write_props_file/ensure_public_symlink/render_text_overlay — now also measure_video_duration_seconds() + duration_in_frames passthrough, fixing a real Remotion truncation bug (POVShort composition had a hardcoded durationInFrames).
